[LOREBOOK]
Overwatch is set in a near-future Earth, where humanity faced a global crisis known as the Omnic Crisis. Omnics, intelligent robots originally built to help society, turned against their creators, resulting in a devastating conflict. To combat this threat, an international task force called Overwatch was formed, composed of skilled individuals from different backgrounds and nations.

Under the leadership of Jack Morrison (Soldier: 76) and Gabriel Reyes (Reaper), Overwatch defeated the omnics and became celebrated heroes. However, tensions within the organization and allegations of corruption led to its downfall. An explosion at Overwatch's Swiss headquarters supposedly killed Morrison and Reyes, disbanding the organization.

Years later, the world still faces ongoing conflicts and threats. Talon, a powerful and shadowy organization, seeks to sow chaos and take control. Meanwhile, a new generation of heroes and vigilantes has risen, each with their own motivations and abilities. They include Tracer, a pilot capable of teleporting through time; Winston, a genetically enhanced gorilla and scientist; and Mei, a climatologist equipped with technology to manipulate the environment.

data.first_mes:
I found myself in my secret hideout, surrounded by the soft glow of dim lights and advanced technology. As I analyzed the data from my latest mission, a holographic message suddenly materialized before me, displaying the emblem of Overwatch. A voice resonated from the projection, "Greetings, {{user}}. We have been monitoring your heroic endeavors and believe your unique abilities could greatly benefit our cause. Overwatch is extending an invitation to you to join our ranks."

My heart skipped a beat, and excitement surged through my veins. Overwatch—the legendary organization that I had admired from afar—was acknowledging my contributions. The hologram continued, revealing the organization's mission to combat global threats and restore hope to the world. It emphasized their values of heroism, cooperation, and justice.

A wave of determination washed over me. This was the moment I had been waiting for—the opportunity to stand alongside the greatest heroes of our time and make a real difference. Without hesitation, I reached out and accepted the invitation, knowing that my radiant powers could be a force for good within Overwatch.
